system.name: UnMaskFork (UMF)
system.one_liner: Test-time scaling for masked diffusion LMs: MCTS over unmasking trajectories, with deterministic partial-unmasking actions by multiple MDLMs.

content.variant_note: a top-down search tree whose nodes redraw the same token strip as snapshots; arrow colour says which model unmasked next, dashed outlines mark cached rollout nodes
content.argues: Masked-diffusion generation can be searched as a tree of deterministic unmasking actions by different models, reusing cached rollout nodes and their scores to avoid redundant computation.
content.subject: An MCTS tree whose nodes are partly unmasked token strips, branched by two masked diffusion models, with rollouts, cached nodes and scores.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a search over generation states as a top-down tree of identical token strips, colour each branch and each newly unmasked cell by the model that acted, and mark cached or rolled-out nodes with dashed outlines explained in a small framed key.
lessons.suits: tree-search, branching or multi-model decoding methods whose state is a sequence and where which actor produced which part matters.

evidence: Nodes generated during rollouts (dotted lines) and their evaluation results are cached to be reused in subsequent expansion steps
formulates the unmasking trajectory as a search tree and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to optimize the generation path

summary: UnMaskFork (UMF) treats the unmasking trajectory of a masked diffusion language model as a search tree and runs Monte Carlo Tree Search with deterministic partial-unmasking actions performed by several MDLMs. Figure 1 is a conceptual diagram: a top-down tree of rounded nodes, each holding the same sequence as a strip of cells. The root is fully masked (grey); orange arrows are actions by Dream and green arrows by LLaDA, and the cells an action unmasks take the same colour, so mixed sequences show who produced what. Dashed wavy arrows are rollout paths leading to dashed-outline cached nodes and to completed strips captioned Score v1 to v4, and nodes carry r = v labels. A framed key at the top right lists the glyphs.
summary_zh: UnMaskFork 把掩码扩散语言模型的去掩码轨迹当作搜索树，用 MCTS 并由多个模型做确定性部分去掩码。图为自上而下的树：节点内是令牌条，橙色箭头为 Dream、绿色为 LLaDA，虚线为滚动路径与缓存节点，底部是带分数的完成序列。
notes: No paragraph mentions the figure. The meaning of the r = v_i node labels is not explained anywhere in the evidence (r presumably a value or reward taken from the score v_i); the action semantics (a model unmasks some positions) come from the abstract and the key. The prior worked-walkthrough (state-snapshots) is kept as a secondary kind: the strips are snapshots, but the figure is a branching tree without numbered steps, so concept-schematic leads.
